targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-779b (MECH-063 sub-claim ii) -- non_contributory, substrate_ceiling. The 779a episode-cap fix verifiably took effect (seed 23 / T1P1: 835 -> 2400 env steps, stop_reason episode_cap -> step_cap, episode_cap_can_bind False) and the precondition did not move: phasic_fires_real_events measured 6 vs threshold 10, the MIN having migrated from T1P1/seed23 (6 -> 13) to T0P1/seed23 (10 -> 6). Root cause is NOT exposure and NOT SD-069 capability (burst_level_max = 1.00 in every PHASIC-ON cell): the phasic regulator resets its surprise-EMA cold at each episode boundary with a ~10-tick time constant, while seed 23's episodes last ~6.9 steps, so its baseline never converges and added steps arrive as more cold restarts. The withholding is CORRECT rather than spurious: diss_seed_count 4 sits at exactly MIN_SEEDS 4 and leave-one-out collapses the verdict for 4 of 5 seeds INCLUDING seed 23, so the load-bearing criterion depends on the very cell the gate flags; seed 23's dR_phasic -0.110 on ~9.5 event ticks is equally well read as small-sample effect-size inflation, and n=5 cannot discriminate. Separately, robust:true used the mean-minus-population-SD idiom retired by MECH-063 autopsy follow-up #4; under the corrected SEM bar the phasic leg fails at k=2 (+0.0179 vs margin 0.02) while the tonic leg passes. Booked as pending_retest_after_substrate against sd_phasic_ema_episode_continuity. MECH-063 remains lit-only (exp_conf 0.0); no demotion -- the probe has not yet let the claim express itself.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Phasic surprise-EMA baseline continuity + convergence-gated event counting
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: PhasicSurpriseBurst.reset() clears the surprise-EMA at every episode boundary, giving a ~10-tick warmup (PHASIC_EMA_DECAY 0.1) against episodes as short as 7 steps, so short-episode seeds structurally under-report n_event_ticks and no step-budget increase can compensate. Build BOTH legs: (a) carry or warm the EMA baseline across episode boundaries so the baseline reflects the agent's surprise distribution rather than the current episode's first tick; (b) gate event-tick counting until the baseline has converged, so a cell reports honestly (or declares itself uninformative) instead of returning a near-zero count that a MIN-across-cells precondition then treats as a real measurement.

learning_extracted: A per-episode cold EMA reset makes an event-rate readout a function of episode length: any surprise-baseline regulator reset at episode boundaries silently under-reports on short-episode seeds, and more total steps cannot compensate because they arrive as more cold restarts.
A MIN-across-cells precondition on a high-variance statistic is a noise draw, and the cell it selects is by construction the least reliable one.
MIN_SEEDS passing at exactly the floor should be reported as fragile -- leave-one-out collapsed 4 of 5 seeds here, and that fragility was invisible in the PASS flag.
An effect size measured on few samples cannot be used to argue that few samples suffice; the inference is circular and needs an independent reliability estimate.
A saturation-headroom precondition checked only on baseline arms does not protect the treatment arms (R5 checks T0P0 only; seed 23's tonic-ON arms reach 0.859 against a 0.98 ceiling).

No recording debt: the always-core is complete. But the script carries no '=== HYPOTHESES UNDER TEST ===' / '=== INTERPRETATION GRID ===' block, contrary to the skill's diagnostic-template requirement.
